## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The empty-criteria regression must be fixed before merge because a requirement without any criteria now counts as proven.

## Changes
The pull request modernizes handler annotations and logging, replaces a sorting lambda with `itemgetter`, and changes requirement proof to compare a sum against the criteria count.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Reject empty criteria when proving a requirement — For `criteria=[]`, you now return `True` instead of `False`: both the sum and length equal zero. The removed `bool(criteria)` guard previously rejected this input. — Release-review callers can accept a requirement as proven without any supporting criteria. — Fix: Preserve the nonempty guard and extend `test_requirement_proof` with the empty-list case.
